evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. According to the original agreement, the term states, "This Agreement continues until terminated" [1].

An amendment to the agreement mentions an effective date but does not establish a fixed end date for the agreement itself. The amendment states, "This Amendment takes effect on 1 June 2026" [8].

No other document in the matter provides a specific end date for the agreement.

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated.
This Amendment takes effect on 1 June 2026.
evidence.document_title: Amendment No. 1 to the Kestrel storage agreement

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that after Amendment No. 1, all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force [1].

The Storage Services Agreement, as amended, includes the following terms that remain in force: 
- The services provided by the Provider, which include storing the Client's archived equipment at the Brookfield facility [3].
- The obligation for the Client to pay a monthly storage fee, which was amended to EUR 4,600 [7].
- The term of the agreement, which continues until terminated [3].

The amendment itself takes effect on 1 June 2026 [8].

evidence.quote: Provider will store Client's archived equipment at its Brookfield facility.
Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,600, invoiced on the first business day of each month.

items.question: How sure is Jonas Ekberg of the time the alarm sounded?
items.answer: Jonas Ekberg is not entirely sure of the exact time the alarm sounded. He states that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026, but he is not sure of the exact minute [1].

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute.

items.question: What was the Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1?
items.answer: The Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1 was EUR 4,000. This is stated in the original Storage Services Agreement, which specifies that "Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month" [2].
